# Benefits Overview

## 1. Health Insurance
The company covers 90% of the medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees, and 75% for dependents. Coverage begins on the first day of the month following your start date. 

## 2. Retirement (401k)
Employees are eligible to participate in the company's 401(k) plan immediately upon hire. The company matches 100% of the first 4% of employee contributions, and 50% of the next 2%. Company matches vest immediately.

## 3. Wellness Program
Employees receive a $100 monthly wellness stipend. This can be used for gym memberships, fitness classes, mental health applications, or ergonomic home office equipment. 

## 4. Professional Development
The company encourages continuous learning. Employees have an annual budget of $1,500 for professional development, which covers conferences, certifications, and online courses. Pre-approval from a direct manager is required.

# Code of Conduct

## 1. Professional Behavior
We expect all employees to foster a collaborative, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Discriminatory, harassing, or bullying behavior of any kind is strictly prohibited and will result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

## 2. Anti-Harassment
The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy towards sexual harassment, racial discrimination, and any other form of harassment. Any incidents should be immediately reported to the HR department or anonymously through the company's whistleblower hotline.

## 3. Conflict of Interest
Employees must avoid any situation where personal interests could conflict with their professional duties. Outside employment or freelance work that competes directly with the company's business must be disclosed and approved by HR.

## 4. Dress Code
We observe a "dress for your day" policy. While casual attire is generally acceptable, employees are expected to dress professionally when meeting with clients or external stakeholders.

# Performance Reviews and Promotions

## 1. Review Cycles
The company conducts formal performance reviews bi-annually, in June and December. These reviews include self-assessments, peer feedback, and manager evaluations. 

## 2. Promotions
Promotions are considered during the December review cycle. Eligibility for promotion requires at least one year of tenure in the current role and a performance rating of "Exceeds Expectations" or higher in the most recent review cycle. 

## 3. Performance Improvement Plans (PIP)
If an employee receives a "Needs Improvement" rating, they may be placed on a 30, 60, or 90-day Performance Improvement Plan (PIP). The PIP will outline specific, measurable goals. Failure to meet these goals within the specified timeframe may result in termination of employment.

## 4. Continuous Feedback
Managers are expected to hold weekly or bi-weekly 1:1 meetings with their direct reports to provide ongoing feedback, independent of the formal review cycles.

# Paid Time Off (PTO) and Leave Policy

## 1. Accrual and Eligibility
All full-time employees accrue 15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, accumulating at a rate of 1.25 days per month. Employees become eligible to use accrued PTO after completing their first 30 days of employment.

## 2. Sick Leave
Employees are granted 10 days of paid sick leave annually on January 1st. Sick leave does not carry over to the next calendar year. A doctor's note may be required for sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive business days.

## 3. Parental Leave
The company provides up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. This is available to all full-time employees who have been with the company for at least 6 months.

## 4. Bereavement Leave
Employees are entitled to 5 days of paid bereavement leave in the event of the death of an immediate family member.

## 5. Holidays
The company observes 10 standard national holidays. If a holiday falls on a weekend, it will be observed on the closest preceding Friday or following Monday.

## Policy Summary
All remote employees are eligible for a $1,200 annual home office stipend. Equipment must be approved by IT and HR. Laptops must meet minimum security specs (TPM 2.0, encrypted SSD). Stipends are reimbursed quarterly via payroll. Violations may result in disciplinary action.

# Information Security and Data Privacy

## 1. Password Policy
All employee accounts must be secured with strong passwords (minimum 12 characters, including numbers and symbols). Passwords must be changed every 90 days. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is strictly required for all company systems.

## 2. Handling of Personal Identifiable Information (PII)
Employees handling customer or employee PII must strictly adhere to data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). PII must never be stored on unencrypted local drives or shared via unauthorized external channels.

## 3. Device Security
Company-issued laptops and mobile devices must remain encrypted using MDM (Mobile Device Management) software. If a company device is lost or stolen, it must be reported to the IT Helpdesk immediately to initiate a remote wipe.

## 4. Acceptable Use of Systems
Company networks and systems are strictly for business use. Downloading unauthorized software or accessing malicious websites is prohibited.

# Travel and Expense Reimbursement

## 1. Travel Booking
All business-related flights and hotels must be booked through the company's designated corporate travel portal (Concur). Flights under 6 hours must be booked in Economy class. Flights exceeding 6 hours may be booked in Premium Economy or Business Class with VP approval.

## 2. Meals and Incidentals
Employees traveling for business are provided a daily per-diem of $75 for meals and incidentals ($100 for high-cost cities like NYC or SF). Receipts are required for any single expense exceeding $25.

## 3. Expense Submission
Expense reports must be submitted via Concur within 30 days of the transaction. Late submissions may be rejected. Reimbursements are typically processed within two payroll cycles.

## 4. Non-Reimbursable Expenses
The following items will not be reimbursed by the company:
- Traffic citations or parking tickets
- Personal entertainment (movies, mini-bar)
- Upgrades for flights or hotels
